fields.question: How old is the person with the symptoms?
fields.description: Age in years. Use decimals for babies (0.5 = 6 months, 0.1 = about 5 weeks).

fields.question: Is the person male, female or other?
fields.description: Sex assigned at birth, used only for pregnancy-related safety questions.

fields.question: Is there any chance of pregnancy?
fields.description: True if pregnant or possibly pregnant.

fields.question: Any long-term conditions, such as diabetes, heart, lung, kidney or liver disease, cancer, or a weak immune system? (Say 'none' if not.)
fields.description: List of canonical condition names. Empty list means the patient said none.

fields.question: How long have the symptoms been going on?
fields.description: Duration in days (0.5 = 12 hours, 7 = one week).

fields.question: Overall, would you say it is mild, moderate or severe?
fields.description: Patient's own rating of how bad the problem is.
